## Decision Outcome

Imprimatur carries 19 of Pocock's skills verbatim (MIT, NOTICE per skill, commit 4ae2317ddb22); only the tracker sentence changes to "Imprimatur itself"; to-spec gets the gates; the analysis skill goes; the issues skill stays for now

Carried: to-spec, to-tickets, wayfinder, grill-with-docs, domain-modeling, research, triage, prototype, codebase-design, implement, implement-spec, tdd, code-review, improve-codebase-architecture, ask-matt, grilling, grill-me, handoff, to-questionnaire (agents/openai.yaml left out). Not carried: setup-matt-pocock-skills (Imprimatur writes docs/agents itself), wizard, pr, retro, diagnosing-bugs, teach, wait-what, writing-for-agents.

Changed text: "If not, tell the user to run /setup-matt-pocock-skills" → Imprimatur is the tracker (docs/agents/issue-tracker.md or its MCP tools). to-spec ends with a "Gates (Imprimatur)" section: stories → design → analyze → tickets, each approval a decision record with links.gate; deltas keyed <capability>--<requirement>.

The issues skill is not removed yet: it carries skills/issues/screenshots.mjs, which the panel's trial screenshots (#158, #159) use, and the GitHub board, sprint and link-access flow Pocock's triage does not have. Left for the user to decide.
